name: Jam
description: Fruit boiled with sugar until it sets — the toast standard.

tcm.note: A preparation rather than a food; the fruit and sugar pull opposite ways.

ayurveda.note: Long boiling with sugar is ushna, whatever the fruit underneath.

unani.note: Garam-tar; murabba is a warming preserve in the Unani record.

histamine.note: Cooked-down fruit with a long shelf life; strawberry and citrus versions carry their own flags.

guna.note: Fresh and simple — the sattvic default for plant food eaten close to how it grew.
